measurement.note: Review SI quantities, units and conversions.

motion.note: Review distance, time and average speed.

forces.title: Moments & simple machines
forces.note: Review force, lever arms and turning effects.

energy.note: Review work, kinetic energy and power.

waves.note: Review wavelength, amplitude and types of waves.

static.note: See electrons transfer and charges attract or repel.

magnet.note: Explore magnetic poles and current-created magnetic fields.

logic.note: Read the AND, OR, NAND and NOR truth tables. Later circuitry goes beyond EGCSE.

led.note: Read how a forward-biased junction emits light; the apparatus discussion is optional.

organic.note: Review alkanes and alkenes. Skip the advanced bonding and aromatic sections for EGCSE.

acids.title: pH and acidity
acids.note: Explore acidic, neutral and alkaline solutions.
